tasks.title: Daily Life
tasks.instruction: Read a page from a website.

layout.body:
How Well Did You Sleep?
In addition to using Health Geek to track your exercise, you can use it to monitor your sleep. Wear the wristband at night. In the morning, upload data to the phone app and get a readout. Here's a sample.
Percentage of Time in Each Sleep Stage
At night, your body moves naturally from one sleep stage to another. Heart rate and movement are used to calculate your sleep pattern.
Light Sleep: The muscles relax. Heart rate and breathing slow down. About half of sleeping time is usually spent in light sleep.
Deep Sleep: The body is deeply relaxed. This stage is critical for physical recovery and growth.
REM (Rapid Eye Movement) Sleep: Brain activity increases, and vivid dreams may occur. Even though the eyes are closed, they move quickly. This stage is essential for memory, learning, and creativity.
Awake: It is normal for a person to wake up several times at night.

options.C: A device that goes on the wrist

questions.analysis: What is Health Geek? 原文依据：In addition to using Health Geek to track your exercise, you can use it to monitor your sleep. Wear the wristband at night. 翻译：除了使用 Health Geek 记录运动，还可以监测睡眠，夜间需佩戴这款腕带设备。 选项分析： (A) An online fitness class 线上健身课程 → 错误，原文无课程相关内容 (B) A blog for posting sleeping tips 分享睡眠技巧的博客 → 错误，核心是监测设备，并非博客 (C) A device that goes on the wrist 一款佩戴在手腕上的设备 → 正确，wristband 腕带，属于穿戴式健康设备 (D) A health and wellness magazine 健康养生杂志 → 错误，文中不是刊物，是智能设备

questions.stem: How is the amount of time in each sleep stage estimated?

options.A: By observing eye and face motions
options.B: By measuring changes in body temperature
options.C: By following a person's breathing patterns
options.D: By monitoring heart rate and body movements

questions.analysis: How is the amount of time in each sleep stage estimated? 原文依据：Heart rate and movement are used to calculate your sleep pattern. 翻译：心率与身体活动数据，被用来测算睡眠状态与各阶段时长。 选项分析： (A) By observing eye and face motions 观察眼部与面部动作 → 错误，仅 REM 提到眼球运动，不是测算方式 (B) By measuring changes in body temperature 测量体温变化 → 错误，原文未提及体温 (C) By following a person's breathing patterns 追踪呼吸节奏 → 错误，呼吸只是浅睡眠特征，不作为测算依据 (D) By monitoring heart rate and body movements 监测心率和身体活动 → 正确，完全对应原文关键句

questions.stem: What percentage of time is usually spent in light sleep?
questions.analysis: What percentage of time is usually spent in light sleep? 原文依据：About half of sleeping time is usually spent in light sleep. 翻译：人们通常有一半的睡眠时间处于浅睡眠阶段。 选项分析： (A) 50 percent 百分之五十 → 正确，half 对应 50%，图表也标注浅睡眠约 50% (B) 25 percent 百分之二十五 → 错误，为快速眼动睡眠占比 (C) 15 percent 百分之十五 → 错误，为夜间清醒时长占比 (D) 10 percent 百分之十 → 错误，为深度睡眠占比
